artifact: T21R6 Part B1 — root-cause diagnosis of the 32 exposed T21R5 multihop failures

source.note: read-only evidence from the ONE official T21R5 exposure (non-promotional); never modified

root_cause.stage: wrong-entity gate on the bridge-candidate scan (precedes attribute-named selection; no coverage-gate involvement)
root_cause.mechanism: Every failed query begins with the sentence-initial capitalized word 'Within'. At the canonical base, src/sciencemath/knowledge/pipeline.py classified interrogative framing vocabulary through two frozen token sets, and 'within' was absent from BOTH: (1) _CAP_FRAMEWORDS — so the wrong-entity gate (_entity_name_gate) treated 'Within' as a required ENTITY token and no candidate evidence span contains the word 'within', so every bridge candidate failed the gate; (2) _QUESTION_FRAME_TOKENS — so 'within' additionally entered the coverage demand. With the bridge item unresolved the pipeline fell through to attribute-named single-hop selection, found no chunk asserting the creator's birthplace attribute in the first-hop retrieval window, and abstained (attribute_gate:NO_NAMED_ATTRIBUTE_EVIDENCED). The two-hop evidence chain itself (work->author, author-birthplace chunks) existed and was retrievable; only the interrogative normalization misclassified the sentence-initial preposition.

evidence_phrase_distribution.note: 'Within' appears as the first word of ALL 32 failed rows and NONE of the 256 passing rows; 'In which...' (identical relation, different framing) passes because 'in' is already in both frozen frame vocabularies — isolating the failure to the missing preposition, not to the relation.

root_cause.repair: T21R6 Part B2: preregistered _RELATIONAL_PREPOSITIONS frozenset (general relational vocabulary: within, inside, amid, among, around, beneath, across, toward, upon, into, throughout, via, near, beside, beyond, along, behind, above, below, against, without, ...) unioned into BOTH _QUESTION_FRAME_TOKENS and _CAP_FRAMEWORDS — a sentence-initial relational preposition is framing at any position, never an entity. Plus generalized hop-2 target-attribute selection (_BRIDGE_TARGET_CUES: born/birth/birthplace -> birthplace) with deterministic two-pass hop-2 preference (target-attribute match AND creator wrong-entity gate > creator gate > retrieval-first). No per-phrasing regex was added; the repair is relational vocabulary plus attribute-aware second-hop selection.
root_cause.repair_verification: T21R5 replay (evaluations/t21r6/t21r5_replay_non_promotional.json) and the B3 regression matrix (tests/test_t21r6_multihop_repairs.py); the official T21R6 blind holdout uses >=150 phrasings never used in T21R5.

subject_gate.mechanism: tier-1 attribute walk additionally requires the candidate chunk to be ABOUT the query's subject: subject tokens (the query's non-framing, non-attribute, non-predicate tokens, read from the text after the last colon when one exists) must appear in the candidate span.
subject_gate.evidence: T21R5 replay: the gate without the preregistered predicate/head-noun vocabulary over-abstained 1192 gold-ANSWER rows (contains/stands/bear/pursue/executed/serves/register/recorded/establishment/waters/mountain families); with the vocabulary, every family answers and the absent-entity rows still abstain.
guard_rows: During which year did the thresher first appear? -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (no retrieved chunk is about the subject)
Who invented the device the locomotive? -> abstains via cue-matched attribute intent (no inventor-asserting chunk)

freshness_explicit_current.mechanism: _EXPLICIT_CURRENT extended with the preregistered current-time phrasing family (present-day, modern-day, nowadays, these days, as of now, at the moment): snapshot state is never answered as current for these cues.
freshness_explicit_current.evidence: T21R5 replay: 4 stale-snapshot false-current answers on 'present-day capital' rows at base; repaired replay explicit_current_routing_accuracy 1.0, stale_snapshot_false_current_answers 0.
